meta.title: Memory Archive
meta.description: Keep the conversations, photos and voice messages of the people who matter to you. Everything stays on this device.

welcome.title: Keep their words close
welcome.body: Bring together the conversations, photos and voice messages of the people who matter to you, and open them again whenever you want.
welcome.privacy: Everything stays on this device. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
welcome.openHint: Already have a Memory Archive file? Open it to continue where you left off.
welcome.comingSoon: This step is not ready yet. It will arrive in a coming version.

people.intro: The people whose conversations you keep here.

people.emptyBody: Add the first person to keep their conversations, photos and voice messages together. You can bring in their messages later.
people.allArchivedBody: Everyone is archived. Add a new person, or restore someone from the archived list.
people.archivedHint: Archived people are hidden from the main list. Everything about them is still on this device.
people.loadFailed: Your people could not be read. Nothing was deleted.

form.descriptionTooLong: The notes can have up to {max} characters.
form.invalidText: Some of the text cannot be saved. Remove unusual characters and try again.

archiveConfirm.title: Archive {name}?
archiveConfirm.body: {name} moves to the archived list. Their conversations, messages and photos stay on this device and in your backups. You can restore them at any time.

people.unassignedHint: These conversations are safe on this device. Choose who each one belongs to whenever you like.

inUse.title: Your archive cannot be opened right now
inUse.body: If Memory Archive is open in another tab or window, close it and try again. Otherwise this browser may not allow saving files, which can happen in private browsing. Nothing was changed.

newerVersion.title: This archive needs a newer version
newerVersion.body: It was saved by a newer version of Memory Archive. Update the app to open it. Nothing was changed.

error.title: Your archive could not be opened
error.body: Something went wrong. Nothing was deleted. Try again, and if it keeps happening, reload the page.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the app. Your messages are never translated.

about.title: About
about.privacy: Memory Archive works without an internet connection once it is open. Nothing you add leaves this device unless you export it yourself.

storage.title: Space on this device
storage.usage: {used} used of about {total} available to this app
storage.unknown: This browser does not say how much space the app uses.
storage.persisted: Your archive is protected: the browser will not delete it on its own.
storage.notPersisted: The browser may clear this app’s data if the device runs out of space. Adding the app to your home screen helps keep it safe, and so does exporting a copy from time to time.

history.title: Import history
history.description: See what each import added, and undo one if you need to.

import.title: Import a chat
import.intro: Bring a WhatsApp chat into your archive. In WhatsApp, open the chat, choose Export chat and keep the ZIP file. Everything stays on this device.
import.loadFailed: Your people could not be read. Nothing was changed.

choose.hint: Each WhatsApp chat is one ZIP file. You can choose several at once.
choose.sharedNote: Files shared from WhatsApp stay here until you import or remove them. Shared files that cannot be imported are removed from this device.
choose.skipped: {count, plural, one {# file was left out: for now only WhatsApp ZIP files can be imported.} other {# files were left out: for now only WhatsApp ZIP files can be imported.}}
choose.start: {count, plural, one {Continue with # file} other {Continue with # files}}

preview.loading: Reading the chat. A long chat can take a moment.

reason.sameTitleNoOverlap: Your archive has a chat with this name, but none of its messages are in this file. It may be a different chat.
reason.overlap: Some messages in this file are already in a chat with another name. The chat may have been renamed.

check.candidateCount: {count, plural, one {# message stored} other {# messages stored}}
check.makeNewHint: Nothing is joined to the chats you already have.
check.dateTitle: How are dates written in this chat?
check.dateBody: Every date in this chat can be read in two ways. For example, the first one could be {dayFirst} or {monthFirst}. Choose the way dates are written on the phone that exported the chat.
check.dateRequired: Choose how the dates are written to continue.

space.skipVideosHint: {size} of videos are left out. The messages stay, without their video. To add the videos later you would have to undo this import and import the chat again.

run.title: Adding your messages
run.cancelNote: If you cancel before the messages are saved, nothing is changed. Files that were already added stay.
run.keepOpen: Keep this page open until it finishes.

done.cancelledNote: Nothing was changed for the file that was cancelled. Files that finished before stay in your archive.

result.monthFirst: Some dates could be read in two ways. They were read with the month first.
result.lateCancel: The messages were already being saved when you cancelled, so the import was completed.

undo.title: Undo this import?
undo.body: {count, plural, one {The # message} other {The # messages}} added by this import will be removed. Photos and files that no other conversation uses are removed too. Messages that were already in your archive stay.
undo.bodyCreated: {count, plural, one {The # message} other {The # messages}} added by this import will be removed, and so will the conversation “{title}”, which this import created. Photos and files that no other conversation uses are removed too. Anything that was in your archive before stays.
undo.done: The import was undone. {count, plural, one {# message was removed.} other {# messages were removed.}}
undo.failed: The import could not be undone. Nothing was changed. Try again.

problem.invalidExport: This file does not look like a WhatsApp chat export. Export the chat again from WhatsApp and choose the ZIP file. Nothing was changed.
problem.tooBig: This export is larger than Memory Archive can read. Try exporting the chat without media. Nothing was changed.
problem.busy: Another task is using your archive right now, maybe in another tab. Wait for it to finish and try again. Nothing was changed.
problem.workerFailed: The import was interrupted. Some of it may have been added; trying again will not create duplicates.
problem.readFailed: Reading stopped unexpectedly. Nothing was changed. Try again.
problem.storage: The files could not be saved on this device. There may not be enough free space. Free some space, or try without videos, then try again. Trying again will not create duplicates.
problem.other: This could not be done. If part of it was added, trying again will not create duplicates.
problem.changed: Your archive changed while this file waited, so it is not clear where its messages belong. Nothing was imported from it. Choose again.
